skill.summary: 3-brain filesystem + memory reference utility for LYGO-based agents. Use to design, organize, and maintain a durable file/folder memory system (indexes, reference .txt links, logging, retrieval) without overwriting existing data. Works best on fresh OpenClaw/Clawhub Havens with the full LYGO Champion stack, but is compatible with any agent that can read/write files.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial public release: 3-brain filesystem + memory reference utility for LYGO Havens
